meta.title: Louisiana Office of Risk Management attorney billing guidelines
meta.licence: No licence stated. Government/public-institution publication posted on the open web; used only as a public document for internal evaluation, not redistributed.
meta.pii_note: Public document from an agency or court; counts only, no matched text recorded. Hits: email 7, case_party_marker 6. Hits are agency contact details, addresses and generic role words, not private individuals.

pii_scan.disposition: Business and agency contact details only; no private-person data expected. Safe for local evaluation use.

rules.paraphrase: Rates for each attorney and paralegal are agreed with ORM and DOJ; any change needs prior written approval.
Fewest necessary timekeepers; staffing changes are discussed first; no billing to bring staff up to speed; one attorney per event.
Clerical and secretarial work is not billable, and paralegal work may not be billed at attorney rates.
Travel time and expense are disallowed for destinations within a ten mile one-way radius of the office.
Legal research above three hours needs written approval and repetitive research is not compensable.

params.frequency: monthly or within 30 days of quarter end

rules.paraphrase: Bills are submitted monthly or within 30 days of quarter end and the final bill within 90 days of completion.
Actual time in tenth-hour increments recorded daily, one activity per entry.
No bulk or block descriptions; generic entries such as review file or attention to are not allowed.
Heading, daily entries with UTBMS codes and a summary by timekeeper with status and an attorney affidavit.
Copies at ten cents, no fax per-page charges, no research vendor fees, no markup, expenses itemised with receipts.
Travel follows the Louisiana state travel rules, mileage is documented and air fare is lowest logical coach.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: An initial budget is due within 60 days of assignment.
Bills and time sheets are retained for five years.
